purpose: Labelled text / email / textarea control on /contact and /referral.
geometry: h-[3em] (input) / h-[3.54em] (textarea), px-[0.9em], text-[1.75em]. EM-CASCADE: mb/px/h all resolve against the element's OWN 1.75em (18.667px @1280), not the root — the spacing classes must stay on the same element as text-[1.75em]. Measured input 444.02x55.98, textarea 444.02x66.08.

states.focus: UA default only — 0 `focus:` classes, computed box-shadow none
states.note: No interactive state exists. A generator must not add one.

validation: NATIVE HTML ONLY: required, type=email, maxlength 256 (5000 on textarea). No custom validation, no inline per-field error, no aria-invalid, no aria-describedby.
labelColourNote: The <label> is #333333, not #000000: a <label> is not matched by `.marketing-root p { color:#000 }`.
